sufficiency_note: Development starting material only. Qualify each new asset component and its scope independently.
purpose: Official retained interface examples plus a labelled synthetic asset scenario. All implementation and measurement remain pending.
original_acceptance: The minimum implementation consumes valid named inputs and meets the reviewed behavior cases; examples/templates alone do not establish completion.
Every mandatory artifact exists or maps to agreed equivalent sections; preserve original evidence and disclose unresolved failures.

Publish the specified baseline/metric results with denominators, measured/not-run state and limitations. A negative result may satisfy research acceptance if the protocol and artifact requirements are met.
Activation, authorization and existing platform boundaries remain enforced; no new owner, command or queue authority is introduced.
Named supporting reviewers reproduce the relevant contract/case check and record findings/disposition.

asset_research_plan.decision: Evaluate a single snapshot plus an explicit as_of time and versioned field policy. Begin with package identity/version and collection time; report usable, stale, missing, conflicting or time_uncertain with reasons.
questions: Which freshness windows and mandatory fields are defensible for each supported asset/collection profile?
How will original collection time, clock uncertainty, partial failure and conflicting observations change usability?
How can consumers inspect the exact reasons instead of relying on an uncalibrated confidence percentage?
Which smallest implementation answers the declared project need, and what evidence would make the extension unnecessary?
asset_research_plan.comparison: Compare latest-received and age-only checks with field-level evaluation on the same reviewed cases. A configured age threshold is an assumption to justify, not a measured universal constant.
cases: An old observation arrives recently — The 300-second value is illustrative only; receipt does not refresh collection time.
No reliable collection time — A receipt timestamp cannot establish the observation age.
One collected field does not fill another — Field-level completeness remains explicit even when one command succeeds.
consumers: C20: field-level gaps/staleness that justify bounded collection probes.
C22/C23: quality states and source coverage for evaluation/relationship qualification.
C13/D09 reviewers: explicit usability reasons; matching and closure decisions remain with their existing components.
asset_research_plan.reviewers: Mahrous checks how evidence usability is consumed by matching/verification without changing their authority.
asset_research_plan.start: C18 history is not a prerequisite for single-observation freshness. Cross-observation conflict resolution is optional; unavailable or contradictory evidence must remain unresolved.

implementation_reference.minimum: Evaluate a single snapshot plus an explicit as_of time and versioned field policy. Begin with package identity/version and collection time; report usable, stale, missing, conflicting or time_uncertain with reasons.
implementation_reference.gate: C18 history is not a prerequisite for single-observation freshness. Cross-observation conflict resolution is optional; unavailable or contradictory evidence must remain unresolved.
implementation_reference.interface: evaluate_evidence(snapshot, field_policy, as_of) → per_field_states, reason_codes, source_refs, policy_revision. Collection time and receipt time are different inputs.
implementation_reference.baseline: Compare latest-received and age-only checks with field-level evaluation on the same reviewed cases. A configured age threshold is an assumption to justify, not a measured universal constant.
metrics: False-usable/false-fresh decisions, missing/conflicting counts and per-profile coverage.
Deterministic replay at fixed as_of; error slices for imports, partial failures and clock uncertainty.
creative: Research field/profile-specific thresholds and alternative conflict policies; predeclare them before evaluating the held-out cases.
Prefer understandable reason codes; a confidence percentage needs separate calibration evidence.
